notes.title: The Ultimate Challenge
notes.content:
[h1]MAJOR EVENT #2021[h1]

[h2][b]The [u]14 Day[/u] Challenge to reach endless "the final m00n"[/b][/h2]


final m00n the battle! Who is the first to reach the mystical and endless final m00n.You have exactly 14 days to complete this challenge. 

Only the strongest will survive ...



[list]
[*]Choose a Spaceship
[*]Choose your level of difficulty
[*]Enter the most hostile environment in game history
[*]And reach the legendary "final m00n"
[/list]

[h3]You only have 14 days to discover what no one has discovered before you[/h3]






May the Cubes be with you...

notes.title: Extensive graphic and gameplay improvements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Endless gameplay expanded and improved
[*] Additional effects in fighting and destroying enemies.
[*] Better interaction of light and shadow
[*] Improved and extended particles
[*] Additional, atmospheric intro implemented
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34117174/a5bf03fd05ccc948a43fbcb4d338a0130494a671.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Major Update:
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Now supports V-sync up to 120 Hz at all monitor resolutions
[*] Improved day and night cycle
[*] Lights and shadows are now visible over infinite distance
[*] Improved "Next Gen" Unreal Engine 4 Post Processing
[*] The endless final m00n has been further improved
[*] Extra enemies & further improved Alien AI
[/list]

notes.title: It is never too late...
notes.content: [h1]final m00n - Defender of the Cubes now supports cross platform STEAM Cloud savegames.[/h1]

notes.title: final m00n doesn't know the word END !
Developer play: final m00n - DotC - The "Arcade Mode"
Minor patch:
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Save every m00n.
[*] Overall faster gameplay.
[*] Increased firepower & damage per second with all ships.
[*] Difficulty adjusted on difficult "Easy", "Normal" & "Hard".
[*] More "Spheres" per ship on difficult "Easy".
[*] Improved "Arcade Mode".
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update: 4K / 10K , UHD, HDR & Ultra-Wide-Screen
notes.content:
[h1]Supports now:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]4K[/b] (UHD-1) and [b]8K[/b] (UHD-2) with [b]HDR[/b] in "[b]Big Picture[/b]" mode on [b]Ultra High Definition Televisions[/b]
[*] [b]Ultra-Wide-Screens[/b] (16:9 / 21:9 / 32:9) as well as [b]UW-UHD[/b] 1440p, [b]UW 4K[/b], [b]UW 5K[/b] and [b]UW 10K[/b]
[*] [b]Improved Texture-Resolutions[/b] up to [b]4K per Texture[/b] and improved shader model for DirectX and Metal.
[/list]
